items.q: What is IIT (ISM) Dhanbad and how old is it?
items.a: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad traces back to 1926, when it opened as the Indian School of Mines to train mining and geology engineers for British India, making it one of the country's oldest engineering institutions. It ran as a specialist mining school and later a deemed university before Parliament converted it into a full-fledged IIT in 2016, keeping the historic "ISM" in its name. The institute marks its centenary around 2026.

items.q: How is IIT (ISM) Dhanbad different from other IITs?
items.a: Unlike most IITs that began as general engineering colleges, ISM Dhanbad started as India's dedicated mining and applied-geology school, so it still carries unusual depth in mining, petroleum, and earth-science departments alongside newer branches like computer science and electronics. It became an IIT only in 2016, decades after the older IITs, through a separate Act of Parliament rather than a founding as an IIT.

items.q: How do I get admission into IIT (ISM) Dhanbad's B.Tech programs?
items.a: B.Tech and integrated B.Tech-M.Tech seats are filled the same way as at every other IIT: candidates clear JEE Advanced and then participate in JoSAA's centralized counselling and seat allotment. Postgraduate entry differs by program — M.Tech admits mainly through GATE, the MBA through CAT, and M.Sc/integrated M.Sc-M.Tech/Ph.D. through the institute's own entrance process.

items.q: What B.Tech branches and departments does IIT (ISM) Dhanbad offer?
items.a: Engineering departments span Mining, Petroleum, Civil, Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, and Environmental Science and Engineering, alongside the Fuel, Mineral and Metallurgical Engineering department. It also runs core science departments — Applied Geology, Applied Geophysics, Physics, Chemistry and Chemical Biology, and Mathematics and Computing — plus Humanities and a Management Studies department.

items.q: What is the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad campus like?
items.a: The institute sits in Sardar Patel Nagar in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, with a main campus of roughly 218 acres, and it has been developing an additional expansion campus of about 227 acres at nearby Nirsa. Campus landmarks students mention include the Student Activity Centre, the heritage Penman Auditorium, the Golden Jubilee Lecture Theatre, and green spaces such as the Oval Garden and Ruby Park.

items.q: What hostel options does IIT (ISM) Dhanbad have?
items.a: Undergraduates are housed across 11 hostels named after gemstones — such as Topaz, Diamond, Emerald, and Sapphire — with seven blocks for men and four for women, and each side includes a wing set aside for international students. Room-sharing and other living arrangements are decided by the hostel administration and can change by year of study.

items.q: How good are placements at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
items.a: In the 2024 placement cycle the institute reported more than 750 students placed, an average package of about ₹13.13 lakh per annum, and a highest package of ₹60 lakh per annum, with recruiters including Google, Microsoft, Accenture, Siemens, Tata Steel, Tata Motors, and Jaguar Land Rover. Figures move year to year, so applicants should check the placement cell's latest report for the most current numbers.

items.q: What are the major fests and student events at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
items.a: Srijan is the institute's large socio-cultural fest, billed as one of the biggest in eastern India, while Concetto is the technical fest and Parakram the sports fest. Khannan is a mining- and technology-themed fest tied to the institute's roots, and Basant is the annual alumni homecoming. Student affairs more broadly run through the elected Students' Gymkhana.

items.q: Where does IIT (ISM) Dhanbad stand in NIRF rankings?
items.a: In the NIRF 2025 rankings the institute placed 15th in the Engineering category, 22nd in Research, 35th overall, and 48th in Management. These positions have stayed roughly in this band across recent NIRF cycles, though exact ranks shift slightly each year, so applicants comparing colleges should confirm the latest published edition.

items.q: Does IIT (ISM) Dhanbad offer an MBA or other management programs?
items.a: Yes. Its Department of Management Studies and Industrial Engineering runs a two-year full-time MBA admitted through CAT scores, alongside the engineering-focused Industrial Engineering and Management coursework the institute has offered since the 1970s. This makes it one of the IITs with a comparatively long-standing management education track.

items.q: Does IIT (ISM) Dhanbad have notable research facilities or partnerships?
items.a: The campus houses an eight-storey Central Research Facility recognised as a Centre of National Importance, and the institute has been described as advising multiple central government ministries on mineral, energy, and mining policy. It also runs AICCET, a joint clean-coal and energy research centre with Curtin University in Australia, plus a mining-environment data centre (ENVIS) dating to 1991.
